launch_command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
root=Path('/workspace/experiments/minicpm-s2/scripts')
for name,expected in {
 'validate_cpu_combination.py':'abfc7981a8d5a20ff32b80f42dd30148bbeb5d680c649bf892e2b3924ead0bad',
 'launch_cpu_combination_gate.py':'d50511c9a194b1dadad87498b22862641cbea9643eea94aa73f32b320a6abb2f',
 'cpu-combination-model_runner.py':'6f918ae6e2f32a1244bb5ac7411a5cffdd5071b1636e899e61ab6f0f20df2141'}.items():
 raw=(root/name).read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==expected,name
 compile(raw,name,'exec')
 print(name,expected)
PY
stamp=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
log="/tmp/minicpm-cpu-combination-$stamp.log"
nohup python3 /workspace/experiments/minicpm-s2/scripts/launch_cpu_combination_gate.py > "$log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
pid=$!
printf 'LAUNCHER_PID=%s\nLAUNCH_LOG=%s\n' "$pid" "$log"
sleep 1
cat "$log"
archive_command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
root=Path('/workspace/experiments/minicpm-s2/framework');r=root/'20261022T062205Z-cpu-combination-gate';c=root/'20261022T062205Z-cpu-combination-gate-control'
assert (c/'exit-code').read_text().strip()=='0'
seal=json.loads((c/'seal.json').read_text())
for name,sha in seal['files_sha256'].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha,name
print(json.dumps({'seal_files':len(seal['files_sha256']),'status':seal['status']}))
PY
archive="/workspace/experiments/minicpm-s2/framework/20261022T062205Z-cpu-combination-gate.tgz"
test ! -e "$archive"
tar -czf "$archive" -C /workspace/experiments/minicpm-s2/framework "20261022T062205Z-cpu-combination-gate" "20261022T062205Z-cpu-combination-gate-control" -C /tmp "minicpm-cpu-combination-20261022T062205Z.log"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
p=Path('/workspace/experiments/minicpm-s2/framework/20261022T062205Z-cpu-combination-gate.tgz')
print(json.dumps({'path':str(p),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
